title: should show alert context menu on right-clicking a scatter chart and navigate to alert creation via above threshold
verifies: a scatter series opens the alert context menu and the above-threshold item routes to the alert form with prefill=panel

title: should not show alert context menu on right-clicking a pie chart (non-cartesian series)
verifies: a non-cartesian pie series right-click produces no alert context menu (whitelist no-op)
